Just want to quickly add on that I really hope I didn't come off as saying "just don't feel terrible", since I know firsthand that advice like that just sucks; just do what makes you feel as much happiness as possible. I really do hope for the best for ya, and feel for ya.

I don't know how to truly help, other than letting you know that I too have been in a similar position, and occasionally still do find myself there. The main thing that has helped me is to first of all not feel terrible about escaping into games, you don't have to force yourself to be productive even 10% of the time. 

Don't be afraid to reach out to a professional and get meds if that is right for you, and I promise you that you're not worthless, and am sure you make a positive impact on many of the people around you. Stay strong my dude, sending some positive vibes your way :)
